name: Igarashi Tooru
source:
[i]"Sorry I took so long, but I'm back now!"[/i]

Sakaki's underling in the Takasato-gumi. Igarashi often visits Murase Clinic, and he's on friendly terms with everyone there.

[From the digital manual included with r59230]
